title: The Radavist Podcast Ep 09: Co-Piloting The Radavist from Socks to Spreadsheets with Cari Carmean
content:
It’s about time we had Cari on the pod! In case you’ve been living under a rock, Cari and John are life and business partners—Cari helps co-pilot this site through lots of unsexy admin work, but she also manages and designs our merch. Tune into the latest episode to get to know Cari, who helps steer this ship in every way from socks to spreadsheets.

Cari Carmean has been involved with The Radavist since the early days, but as a self-described “back of house” presence, Cari’s work is often behind the scenes. In the latest episode of The Radavist Podcast, Hailey talks with Cari about her background in design, sign-painting and why her favorite way to ride a bike is city commuting.
